product.title: Sara Miller Woodland Tales Porcelain 22ct Gold Christmas Tree Decorations, Set of 3, Multi
product.description:
Bring the magic of a winter wonderland to your festive decor with this enchanting trio of Christmas decorations from the Sara Miller London Portmeirion Woodland Tales collection. Each disc-shaped ornament features a heartwarming scene of playful bunnies celebrating the season in a whimsical woodland setting. Hang up the ornaments using the included ribbons.

A wonderful gift-boxed present for someone special, made of porcelain with 22-carat gold detailing.

Choose the perfect china

All our china is made from clay and kiln-fired for durability. Except for pieces with special trims, everything is dishwasher-safe. Below are a few options to consider when choosing your perfect china.

EarthenwareStrong and practical, earthenware is often a little thicker than other ceramics, making it ideal for everyday use.
StonewareFired at high temperatures, stoneware is very tough and heat-resistant. It comes in a number of different glaze finishes.
PorcelainAffordable yet luxurious, porcelain is renowned for its translucency. Fired at high temperatures, porcelain has an extremely tough glazed surface, making it durable.
Fine china The synthetic bone ash used in fine china makes it a more affordable alternative to bone china. Like bone china, it's strong, translucent and delicate, and creamier in colour.
New bone china A type of porcelain with added calcium oxide to achieve a similar aesthetic as bone china, but without animal bone ash.
Bone china White bone china is the strongest and most translucent ceramic. Though it looks delicate, it's tough enough for daily use and is usually dishwasher-safe. It contains at least 35% bone ash.

product.title: Georg Jensen Christmas Collectibles 2026 Mini Mobiles Tree Decorations, Set of 3, Gold
product.description:
This trio of 18-carat gold-plated mobiles, originally created in the late eighties and early nineties, is now reissued in a miniature size, making them true collector's pieces. The series includes the 1988 'Holly' by Lene Munthe, shaped by the distinctive form of its leaves; the 1989 'Angel' by celebrated Danish designer Nanna Ditzel; and Jette Frölich’s 1992 Christmas mobile featuring a braided heart and flying birds, a symbol of freedom.

Each piece features classic festive motifs and hangs from a striking red ribbon, adding a touch of tradition to any Christmas tree.

product.title: Georg Jensen Christmas Collectibles 2026 Drum Mobile Tree Decoration, Gold
product.description:
The 2026 edition of Georg Jensen’s annual Christmas mobile is the defining piece of this year's musical Christmas theme, expressed through a collection inspired by the music and melodies so closely connected to the holiday season.

The mobile takes the form of a drum wrapped in a swirling band of musical notes, drawing inspiration from the beloved Danish Christmas song 'Højt fra træets grønne top' ('High on the Tree’s Green Top'), written by Peter Faber in 1847 and traditionally sung in Denmark on Christmas Eve as families gather around the tree. Lyrics from the song are also engraved in the gold-plated ribbon that surrounds the drum.

The mobile is plated in 18-carat gold and comes with a sleek ribbon in two colours: classic red and a deep red created especially for Georg Jensen's 2026 Christmas Collectibles.

This tree is potted and pre-lit with battery-operated LEDs, with a timer that automatically switches the lights on at the same time each day and off after 8 hours. All you need to do is dress it with decorations and decide where it should go.

Simple to set up, the branches drop easily into place, requiring a small amount of "tweaking" to create the fullest effect.

The small, decorative light bulbs give your tree or room a wonderful sparkle with a softer light output to create atmosphere.

Benefits of Micro LEDs:

  • Energy efficient
  • Consume up to 90% less power than incandescent bulbs
  • Long LED lifespan
  • Micro LED lighting uses "bare look wire", which gives a pleasing "shape" to your Christmas tree

product.title: Meri Meri x John Derian Xmas Garland Set, 1.8m, Multi
product.description:
Meri Meri has collaborated with renowned New York–based artist and designer John Derian on a winter collection infused with magic and seasonal charm.

This set of Christmas garlands creates a wonderland of foliage, flowers, birds and mushrooms, along with a “Merry Christmas” message. Crepe paper, gold foil, tissue paper, glitter and wooden beads combine to make opulent decorations. Hang them together for a statement effect or separately to spread the joy throughout your home. Pack away after the celebrations and bring out year after year for a beautiful display in your home. Length is 1.8 metres.

Founded in 1989, the John Derian Company is celebrated for its handcrafted decoupage, created by artisans in its New York City studios. Derian began his career with a small collection of handmade plates, building a practice that blends historical illustration with a modern, whimsical sensibility.

Derian's work has since expanded to collaborations with international brands across stationery, ceramics and furniture, and is sold at his Manhattan stores and select boutiques worldwide. The John Derian Picture Book, published in 2016, became a New York Times bestseller, followed by Picture Book II.

product.title: Nkuku Adiela Wreath, Green
product.description:
The Adiela wreath captures the quiet beauty of winter woodland. A soft blend of mossy greens and silvery greys creates an organic, asymmetrical base, while sculptural thistles add a hint of wild elegance. Inspired by the textures and tones of a walk through the woods, it brings a rustic, natural charm to seasonal decorating, perfect for hanging on doors, mantels, or walls.

The base of the wreath is handcrafted using panchu sticks, mixed with natural bark and plant skin fibres to achieve both strength and texture. Each stick is carefully wound into a circular form to create a sturdy foundation. The greenery and thistles are then artfully arranged by hand, giving every wreath a unique, naturally sculpted appearance.
